svg.aria-label: pipekit-ops on the GeoStack role ladder: Sequential, Graph, the wrappers, Map and the observers as recipes, Operator and the ready-made operators as steps, jit_report as an algorithm, no models or strategies of its own, saving, hashing and carrier functions as primitives, and signatures, adapters, stores and results as structures; run-time context and setup sit beside the ladder, all on the Python standard library.
